name: NanoXplore Inc.
summary: NanoXplore Inc., a graphene company, manufactures and supplies graphene powder for use in industrial markets in the United States, Canada, France, Switzerland, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Advanced Materials, Plastics, and Composite Products; and Battery Cells and Materials. The company offers graphene-based solutions, including GrapheneBlack powder and graphene-enhanced masterbatch pellets. It also provides silicon-graphene-enhanced Li-ion battery for the energy storage, industrial, and defence markets.
